5.t: There are two different kits available for Eco Fighter. The first kit below is the full kit which includes PCB, all necessary graphics, buttons, joysticks and a volume/test bracket. This kit is used for a cabinet that will be upgraded with the CPS II board for the first time. The second kit is called the "B" Kit. This kit is for any that already uses the CPS II board (Super Street Fighter II). This kit includes the "B" board, all necessary graphics and volume/test bracket. You just remove the top cartridge off the motherboard and replace with the new cartridge.
